text:
sara: Hey — canary for my-service started crashlooping right after today's deploy, 4/4 canaries failing with CrashLoopBackOff. Seen in eu-west-1. Anyone oncall?
lee: I'm here, paging PD and looking. which deployment name?
sara: deployment/my-service-canary, image my-service:v2.3.1, the change was new podAffinity/antiAffinity in the kustomize overlay.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-7892 assigned to lee
lee: acked PD-7892. grabbing logs and pod status.
sara: quick paste of outputs — pods keep restarting and liveness probe fails rapidly:
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=my-service,canary
NAME                           READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
my-service-canary-abcde        0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   6          6m

kubectl -n prod logs my-service-canary-abcde -c encoder
Error: failed to mmap shared memory: permission denied
runtime: failed to create shared memory segment
/entrypoint.sh: line 42: exec: ./encoder: Cannot allocate memory
```
jessica: From the console we also see HPA autoscaled the canary group to 6 then nodes started getting cordoned/drained in eu-west-1 for maintenance, evictions spiked.
matt: Metrics: 502 rate for low-lat endpoints jumped ~8% in eu-west-1 coinciding with deploy. Some customer 99th latency regressed.
lee: two things colliding: affinity change placed pods on nodes undergoing drain; maybe overlay removed hostIPC or hostPath /dev/shm mount so encoder can't mmap. Node drain + HPA + affinity = eviction & crashloops.
sara: what's the fastest mitigation? We need to stop customer impact and get stable traffic back.
lee: Options: 1) flip the feature flag routing to stop sending traffic to canary (fast) 2) scale the canary down/rollback to previous ReplicaSet (fast) 3) patch manifest and reapply (slower) — I recommend kill-flag + scale-down now.
jessica: agreed, kill flag first so we stop any experiment routing. then scale down RS. Postmortem can cover why overlay changed the mount.
matt: I'm going to confirm routing; if the FF is off we should see errors drop in ~1 minute.
sara: flipping feature flag now: toggling ff/deploy_affinity_canary -> OFF (via internal FF console).
sara: :white_check_mark: flag toggled -> OFF
deploy-bot: Traffic policy update applied: canary traffic weight set to 0%
matt: graph already showing error rate dropping to baseline for stable routes. good.
lee: scaling down canary RS now:
```
kubectl -n prod scale rs my-service-canary --replicas=0
replicaset.apps/my-service-canary scaled
```
sara: scaled to 0, pods terminating. Confirming no new crashloops.
lee: PD incident note: mitigation executed (flag OFF + canary scaled to 0). continuing to monitor for fallout.
jessica: customer impact summary for ticket: transient 5xx spike (~8% of requests) in eu-west-1 for ~6 minutes affecting low-latency endpoints, degraded 99th latency for small subset of customers. No data loss.
matt: creating incident ticket INC-2026 with timeline and notes, assigning to eng-runtime for root cause.
sara: quick root-cause hypothesis: kustomize overlay accidentally removed required hostIPC/hostPath or set securityContext that prevented mmap; combined with new affinity rules placed pods on nodes under drain and HPA forced scale attempts.
lee: handing off to next on-call: @matt you're taking follow-up on-call for 2h to validate rollout fixes and coordinate a safe redeploy once fix is ready.
matt: ack handoff. I'll coordinate a patch branch and a canary re-deploy plan (will include explicit nodeSelector check and add preflight liveness guard).
incident-bot: Incident PD-7892 resolved by mitigation. Severity: Sev2. Follow-up: INC-2026 created.
sara: thanks everyone. I'll start a short postmortem draft and include the fix checklist (validate hostIPC, affinity, node drain window, HPA limits).
lee: closing Slack thread for now, will reopen if any new regressions show up.
